info.title: v2.product.get_all_vehicle_list
info.description: Use this Open API to get all vehicle list.

get.description: Use this Open API to get all vehicle list.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: If language is not uploaded, the default language=en, the following are the languages supported by different markets SG: en ; MY: en / ms-my / zh-hans ; TH: en / th ; VN: en / vi ; PH: en ; TW: en / zh-hant ; ID: en / id ; BR: en / pt-br ; MX: en / es-mx ; CO: en/es-CO ; CL: en/es-CL. Note: For markets that have already launched global tree, Crossboard shop only support returning en and zh-hans language data

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Specifies the starting entry of data to return in the current call. Default is 0, if data is more than one page, the offset can be some entry to start next call.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: The size of one page. Max=100

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/product/get_all_vehicle_list?access_token=access_token&language=pt-br&offset=0&page_size=10&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
